 Medium
 Large
 Print Krafton India has announced a new set of features and reward-driven experiences for BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE INDIA (BGMI) with the upcoming 4.7 update, scheduled to roll out on November 18, 2026. The update will introduce the Popularity Battle Annual Gala, a redesigned Mode Selection screen, and a new seasonal rewards event called Chicko's Loot. The company said the Popularity Battle Annual Gala will serve as an expanded version of BGMI's existing player recognition format, offering players more opportunities to compete for in-game honours and rewards. Registrations for the event will open on November 18, while the main competition is scheduled to run from November 25 to December 27. A Team Popularity Battle will follow in December. Popularity Battle gets bigger stage
 According to Krafton India, the Annual Gala will feature a more competitive structure with nine ranking tiers. The event will culminate in an exclusive top tier limited to 3,000 players. Each round of the competition will contribute towards a final Peak Battle, which will determine the rewards earned by participants. Players who secure top rankings will receive exclusive in-game recognition reflecting their status within the BGMI community. KRAFTON is also introducing a new Starlight Grand Prize, which will be open to all registered participants. The company said additional methods for earning points during the competition will be announced when the event goes live. Revamped mode selection interface
 The 4.7 update will also bring a redesigned Mode Selection screen aimed at simplifying navigation across game modes. The new interface will be divided into two sections, "Mine" and "Discover." While the Mine section will provide quick access to a player's preferred game modes, Discover will allow users to explore new gameplay experiences. The updated interface will be released in phases following the update rollout. Chicko's Loot event starts November 20

 Alongside the gameplay and interface changes, BGMI players will gain access to a new seasonal rewards programme called Chicko's Loot starting November 20, 2026. The event will remain active until January 21, 2027. Players will be able to collect Lucky Eggs by participating in different game modes or receiving them as gifts from friends. These Lucky Eggs can then be exchanged for rewards through a dedicated Event Shop. KRAFTON also confirmed that a mini-game centred around Lucky Eggs will be introduced in December as part of the event. Rollout details
 The BGMI 4.7 update will become available on November 18, 2026. Registration for the Popularity Battle Annual Gala will remain open until November 24, with the main event beginning on November 25. Chicko's Loot will start on November 20, while the redesigned Mode Selection screen will be rolled out gradually to players.
